executive_summary: Comprehensive architectural walkthrough of zero-egress CMAF video streaming, KEDA Spot autoscaling, sub-5ms ONNX live chat moderation, and Shoppable CV.

chapters.title: Sub-5ms Go Trie + Int8 ONNX Chat Moderation

mcqs.question_text: What chunk duration and container format does the CMAF transcoding pipeline output?
mcqs.explanation: FFmpeg encodes 2-second keyframe-aligned (-g 48) fragmented MP4 (.m4s) CMAF chunks shared by HLS and DASH.

mcqs.question_text: How does the platform achieve zero bandwidth egress cost from origin storage to CDN?
options: By storing all raw and processed CMAF chunks in Cloudflare R2 paired with Cloudflare CDN
mcqs.explanation: Cloudflare R2 charges $0.00/GB egress to Cloudflare CDN compared to AWS S3's $0.09/GB.

mcqs.question_text: Why does real-time whiteboard sharing consume less than 5 kbps during live sessions?
options: It streams 4K 60fps screen-share video over RTMP
It syncs vector stroke coordinates via Yjs Conflict-Free Replicated Data Types (CRDTs) as Uint8Array deltas
It sends JPEG screenshots every second
It requires viewers to refresh the browser manually
mcqs.explanation: Yjs CRDT syncs only binary vector stroke coordinates (<5 kbps) rather than heavy video pixels.
